assumptions.name: beta
assumptions.justification: Regressed against S&P 500 on monthly total returns to 2026-09-11, over 71 paired observations. The proxy and the window are both judgements and both change the answer, which is why this is a proposal rather than an input.

assumptions.name: capex_intensity
assumptions.justification: The mean of capital expenditure over revenue across 5 period(s) ending 2022-06-30, 2023-06-30, 2024-06-30, 2025-06-30, 2026-06-30. The individual observations were 0.1205, 0.1326, 0.1814, 0.2291, 0.3494.

assumptions.name: depreciation_intensity
assumptions.justification: The mean of depreciation and amortisation over revenue across 5 period(s) ending 2022-06-30, 2023-06-30, 2024-06-30, 2025-06-30, 2026-06-30. The individual observations were 0.0736, 0.0637, 0.0816, 0.0994, 0.1175.

assumptions.name: ebit_margin
assumptions.justification: The mean of operating income over revenue across 5 period(s) ending 2022-06-30, 2023-06-30, 2024-06-30, 2025-06-30, 2026-06-30. The individual observations were 0.4206, 0.4177, 0.4464, 0.4562, 0.4678.

assumptions.name: exit_multiple
assumptions.justification: Cross-checked against the derived assumptions rather than to a peer set (none was retrievable from the XBRL-only documents). At 44.2% EBIT margin, 8.7% D&A, 17.5% tax, a Gordon check at 3% growth and ~8.5% WACC implies ~12-13x EV/EBITDA if capex normalises toward D&A, and only ~8-9x if capex stays at the derived 20.3% of revenue (FY26 alone was 34.9%). 14x allows modest credit for franchise durability. Where the two disagree, I regard the perpetuity growth as the better estimate of terminal value: the datacenter buildout makes EBITDA a poor proxy for terminal cash flow. Sustained capex above D&A would push this toward 10x.

assumptions.name: revenue_growth
assumptions.justification: The compound annual growth rate of revenue from 2022-06-30 to 2026-06-30, over 4 year(s): revenue moved from 198,270,000,000 to 331,839,000,000. Held flat across the forecast, because a trailing rate is one number and projecting a fade is a judgement this derivation does not make.

assumptions.name: tax_rate
assumptions.justification: The mean of income tax expense over pre tax income across 5 period(s) ending 2022-06-30, 2023-06-30, 2024-06-30, 2025-06-30, 2026-06-30. The individual observations were 0.1311, 0.1898, 0.1823, 0.1763, 0.1940.

assumptions.name: terminal_growth
assumptions.justification: Taken to be below a cost of capital of roughly 8-9% for a AAA-tier mega-cap; 3% clears any ordinary WACC for this business. It sits near the top of the permitted band because the terminal engine is Agents and Infra ($268.1B revenue, $136.4B operating income in restated FY26), with Azure at $101.9B and commercial RPO +99% to $627B — a category still growing. It is not the 13.7% trailing CAGR: no firm compounds above nominal GDP in perpetuity. Evidence of cloud/AI demand plateauing, or Devices and Consumer decline broadening, would argue for 2.0-2.5%.

assumptions.name: working_capital_intensity
assumptions.justification: The mean of net working capital — current assets less current liabilities — over revenue, across 5 period(s) ending 2022-06-30, 2023-06-30, 2024-06-30, 2025-06-30, 2026-06-30. A negative figure is normal for a business paid before it pays, and is proposed as it stands rather than floored at zero.

outstanding.name: risk_free_rate
outstanding.reason: No macroeconomic series has been acquired for this run, so there is no published government yield to propose. Enter the rate you are using and say which instrument and date it is from.

outstanding.name: equity_risk_premium
outstanding.reason: The equity risk premium is a judgement with no series behind it, and no role in this platform proposes one. Enter the premium you are using and cite where it comes from.
